chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ibn Mahboub from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The height of the wall of the Mosque of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was one qamah (stature). So he (peace be upon him and his family) would say to Bilal: 'When the time enters, O Bilal, climb above the wall and raise your voice with the Adhan, for Allah has assigned a wind with the Adhan that raises it to the sky. And indeed, the angels, when they hear the Adhan from the people of the earth, say: 'These are the voices of the community of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) affirming the Oneness of Allah, Mighty and Majestic,' and they seek forgiveness for the community of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) until they finish from that Salat.'

key_terms.بِلَال: Bilal (the companion known for his voice)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of the Adhan according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the Prophet’s specific instruction to Bilal to elevate his voice above the mosque wall, emphasizing the acoustic and spiritual amplification of the Adhan. It underscores the Shia understanding of the Adhan as a celestial event where angels actively listen and intercede for the Ummah, linking the earthly call to heavenly worship.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammd, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The height of the wall of Masjid of Rasool-Allahsaww was of one stature. So hesaww was saying to Bilal: ‘When the time comes, O Bilal, climb above the wall and raise your voice with the Azān, for Allahazwj has Allocated a wind with the Azān raising it to the sky, and that the Angels, when they are hearing the Azān from the inhabitants of the earth, they are saying: ‘Voices of the community of Muhammadsaww (affirming) the Oneness of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic’, and they are seeking Forgiveness for the community of Muhammadsaww until they are free from that Salāt’.
en.sarwar: 31. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from ibn Mahbub from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

the height of the wall of the Masjid of the Messenger of Allah was equal to the height of a man. He, the Messenger of Allah would say to Bilal, ‘When time comes, O Bilal, climb on the wall and raise your voice with Adhan. Allah has assigned a wind to raise Adhan to the heaven and that the angels upon hearing Adhan from the people of earth say, “This is the voice of the followers of Prophet Muhammad about oneness of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious.” They ask forgiveness for the followers of Muhammad, O Allah grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, until they complete that prayer.’”
